label: Terrain & Surface State
description: The surface a vehicle is working, and what that surface has done to it. The one cross-axis gap the terrain-by-vehicle matrix found that is not a composition artifact: only rally answered mud and gravel, and nothing at all answered snow, sand or ice.

items.name: deep-mud
items.text: deep churned mud packed solid into every arch and recess, thrown up the flanks in overlapping arcs and still wet where it is thickest
items.text_short: deep mud packed into the arches, thrown up the flanks

items.name: mud-ruts
items.text: twin ruts cut into saturated ground, water standing in the bottom of them and the crown between scraped by the underbody
items.text_short: twin ruts with water standing in the bottom

items.name: wet-clay
items.text: slick wet clay giving no purchase at all, a thin bright film over everything and the tread filled smooth
items.text_short: slick wet clay, tread filled smooth

items.name: loose-gravel
items.text: loose gravel breaking away under load, stones pattering off the arches and a dust plume standing where the car has been
items.text_short: loose gravel breaking away, dust plume standing

items.name: shale-scree
items.text: broken shale scree shifting downhill under the tyres, plates ringing as they slide over one another

items.name: deep-sand
items.text: deep soft sand with tyres aired down and bulging, tracks filling in behind almost as fast as they are made
items.text_short: deep sand, tyres aired down and tracks refilling

items.name: dune-crest
items.text: a dune crest with the wind stripping sand off the edge in a continuous sheet, the far face dropping away steeply
items.text_short: dune crest with sand stripping off the edge

items.name: salt-crust
items.text: a dry lake salt crust in hexagon plates, absolutely flat to the horizon, white dust worked into every seam of the bodywork
items.text_short: hexagon salt crust, flat to the horizon

items.name: packed-snow
items.text: packed snow ground to a polished sheen in the wheel tracks, banks thrown up either side and studs biting audibly
items.text_short: packed snow polished in the wheel tracks

items.name: fresh-powder
items.text: fresh powder deep enough to bury the sills, thrown up in a soft continuous bow wave that hangs in the air behind
items.text_short: fresh powder thrown in a soft bow wave

items.name: black-ice
items.text: black ice reading as wet tarmac and behaving as glass, a mirror finish holding the sky and no texture anywhere
items.text_short: black ice, a mirror finish reading as wet tarmac

items.name: rutted-ice-track
items.text: a studded ice track cut into grooves by the field, ice chips banked at the edge and blue showing where the surface has been carved back
items.text_short: studded ice track carved into blue grooves

items.name: wet-tarmac
items.text: wet tarmac holding a hard reflection of every light, standing water pushed out in fans and spray hanging behind
items.text_short: wet tarmac reflecting hard, spray hanging behind

items.name: dry-hot-tarmac
items.text: dry tarmac hot enough to shimmer, rubber laid down black through the braking zone and tar bleeding at the joints
items.text_short: hot dry tarmac, rubber laid black into the braking zone

items.name: cobbled-pave
items.text: rough cobbled pave hammering the suspension, stones crowned and uneven, everything on the car vibrating out of focus
items.text_short: cobbled pave hammering everything out of focus

items.name: river-crossing
items.text: a river crossing at axle depth, a bow wave standing off the front and water finding its way up the doors
items.text_short: river crossing at axle depth, bow wave standing

items.name: flooded-road
items.text: a flooded road with the surface gone entirely under standing water, depth guessed from the kerb line alone
items.text_short: flooded road, depth guessed from the kerb line

items.name: desert-corrugations
items.text: desert corrugations running across the track in endless ridges, the whole vehicle buzzing and every fixing working loose
items.text_short: desert corrugations buzzing every fixing loose
